decisions.reason: A quantified customer benefit of more than €600,000 per year puts this product clearly above a plausible aspiration level, so a mature German machinery firm would be very likely to continue it.
Having its own product page signals commitment and at least initial commercial relevance, and with no evidence of underperformance the firm would likely keep it while learning from the market.

This product has only a weak public market signal so far, but because it is very new and the firm likely has enough organizational slack, management would more likely retain it for another year than withdraw it immediately.
The product is at least still being mentioned after launch and there is no clear sign of results below aspiration, so the firm would probably keep it while monitoring whether stronger demand emerges.
